plugin.description: Ctrl+clicks backpack items that are not marked keep into the open left panel.
settings.hint: Green cells are kept. Press the key while inventory and a left panel (stash or NPC shop) are open. Each other occupied cell is Ctrl+clicked. Do not use this while the character sheet is the left panel.
settings.delay.tooltip: After each click finishes, the cursor stays on that item for a new random time in this range, then moves.
status.panels: Open inventory and a left panel (stash or NPC shop).
status.kept: Every occupied cell is marked keep.
status.no_match: No backpack item widgets were found on the right panel.
status.window: Game window size is not ready.
